english.note: Use this as the everyday choice for replacing or swapping one thing for another.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when exchanging something for a new or equivalent one.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for giving or exchanging one thing for another.
This is the all-purpose choice for swapping one thing for another or changing places.
Use this for replacing one thing with another, including changing clothes when the context makes that clear.
